title: FastF1 Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fastf1:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(session_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many FastF1 session events land each day and how many distinct session type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest FastF1 session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct session type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much FastF1 session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
